premise: Gull lands on the sand castle's tallest tower and it starts to crumble; the bucket and spade patch it up, and Gull becomes the castle's loudest guard.
inspiration: The 'king of the castle' playground rhyme, turned from a shove into a job: the one who nearly knocked it down ends up guarding it.
lesson: When you wobble something, help fix it.

en-US.title: The Gull on the Castle
en-US.text: [proudly] There stood {castle:enter} a sand castle, with three towers and a little red flag. {castle:live flag} The flag fluttered in the breeze. {seagull:enter} Gull saw it from the sky. {seagull:face happy} [excited] What a perfect place to sit! {seagull:go on castle} Down she swooped, onto the tallest tower. {castle:wobble} Wobble, wobble. {seagull:face surprised} [nervously] Oh dear… {castle:shake} {sfx:crumble} The tower began to crumble. {seagull:live squawk} Gull squawked! [short pause] Then {bucket:enter} the bucket and spade got busy. {bucket:live dig} Scoop! Pat! Scoop! Pat! More sand for the tower, patted nice and firm. {castle:pulse} The tower stood straight and strong again. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live preen} Gull fluffed up her feathers. From the top of the tallest tower, {seagull:live look-around} she could see far across the water. [playfully] And from that day on, Gull was the guard of the sand castle. {castle:sparkle} The very best guard. And the loudest.

es-ES.title: La gaviota del castillo
es-ES.text: [proudly] Allí estaba {castle:enter} un castillo de arena, con tres torres y una banderita roja. {castle:live flag} La bandera ondeaba con la brisa. {seagull:enter} Gaviota lo vio desde el cielo. {seagull:face happy} [excited] ¡Qué sitio perfecto para sentarse! {seagull:go on castle} Bajó en picado, hasta la torre más alta. {castle:wobble} Tambaleo, tambaleo. {seagull:face surprised} [nervously] Ay, madre… {castle:shake} {sfx:crumble} La torre empezó a desmoronarse. {seagull:live squawk} ¡Gaviota graznó! [short pause] Entonces {bucket:enter} el cubo y la pala se pusieron manos a la obra. {bucket:live dig} ¡Zas! ¡Plas! ¡Zas! ¡Plas! Más arena para la torre, bien apretada. {castle:pulse} La torre volvió a estar derecha y fuerte. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live preen} Gaviota ahuecó las plumas. Desde lo alto de la torre más alta, {seagull:live look-around} veía muy lejos sobre el agua. [playfully] Y desde aquel día, Gaviota fue la guardiana del castillo. {castle:sparkle} La mejor guardiana. Y la que más gritaba.
